name: Hang underneath
cue: Use an overhand grip and brace in a straight line from heels to head.

name: Begin the pull
cue: Pull your shoulder blades together and start bending your elbows.

name: Pull upward
cue: Keep your plank as your chest travels toward the bar.

name: Chest to bar
cue: Squeeze your shoulder blades and bring your chest to the bar.

name: Lower smoothly
cue: Lower along the same path without dropping your hips.

name: Finish lowering
cue: Continue to full arm extension while keeping your body straight.
